title: The Ancestry of Stories — Version 0.3
scope: Prototype knowledge graph of cultural and creative transmission across world/environment, person/formation, work/expression, and the mediators that carry material between them.
method_note: Version 0.3 explicitly tests direct creator influence against mediated transmission through works, translations, publishing institutions, traditions, media forms, and historical systems.
limitations: Curated seed corpus, not a representative sample of world literature.
Graph density reflects research attention and source accessibility as well as represented relationships; it must not be interpreted as cultural importance.
The project remains Western- and English-language-heavy and is incomplete in non-English scholarship, oral/community sources, translations, and intermediary transmission.
Coverage metadata describes the state of project research, not the richness of a creator or culture.
Edges marked review require stronger or more specific sourcing before publication as authoritative claims.
Approximate dates are used for some traditions and composite ancient works.
